reviews.review:
Compared against the Mass Effect OT, this game clearly fails to capture the same magic, but it's still judged a bit too harshly. The bar was set impossibly high and that this followed up the closure of the OT, which itself ended quite controversially (and rushed), pretty much doomed it to failure, at least initially. It seems people are slowly coming around to it's charm since it's gameplay really is solid, and the characters, though not as memorable as Wrex, Garrus, Tali, Liara, etc., still have their place. The writing a major "Achilles' heel" of this game, but it does improve as the story progresses. 

Basically, if you ever wanted to play an open-world game set in the Mass Effect universe, minus the exemplary writing, iconic characters, and decade-long buildup, you should give this a chance. Especially discounted as it now is!

Y'know, I kinda like Peebee.

Gameplay's like DA Inquisition with jumpjets and shotguns.

Still has some issues since release, but nothing immediately gamebreaking as of writing this.

This game doesn't get enough love, not form it's long gone devs, not form the playerbase. The game is still worth playing, the visuals hold up, the story for the most part is solid and the character developement of the companions is decent.

The worst is seeing the enormous potential of the game that was not realized. Lots of quests and regions of the game feel unfinished or rushed through. Major events fell rushed through: You just discovered a new sentient species in a new galaxy... 5 min later is like you've always known them. You just discovered an ancient AI that holds knowledge long gone... welp put it in the closet.

Sadly I can't recommend Andromeda, and I'm sad about it. There are some nuggets shining in it, the overall gameplay is very crisp and is just a bit weaker than DA: Vailguards'.

But there are so many infuriating stepping stones making the game an absolute drudgery.
The dialogues are boring, non sensical and often useless. Fast skipping doesn't make the game worse in any way.
Also you waste a lot of time with all the Travel animations, which quickly add up and are absolutly annoying and the one biggest reason I have to quit this game. All other things I could swallow, but wasting my time this much makes me mad.

Otherwise its an ok game, but if you are fine with an ok game, better play Starfield, as it's somehow very similar in its overall gameplay loop and setting but better.

I always felt wasting time I could spent playing a more entertaining game. That's not a good sign.
